icons.name: stopwatch
icons.prompt: Create one polished launcher app icon matching the supplied original M5 StopWatch firmware reference image. Reference is style guidance only. Single centered luminous translucent glass object on pure black #000000 square background, rich saturated luminous color, restrained soft bloom, fine white edge highlights, gently beveled glass volume, frontal view, simple strong silhouette. Match the compact original icons' proportions and soft material. Artwork occupies about 75% of square, glow fits completely inside, generous black edge. Native intended display is exactly 150 x 150 pixels on AMOLED, so keep forms legible at this small size. Deliver a single square icon, ideally exactly 150x150 pixels. No words, lettering, watermark, app label, frame or presentation board. Subject a bright emerald green circular stopwatch, translucent rim, small rounded silver top push button, single diagonal luminous hand. Close style correspondence to the reference's first icon.
